interpretation.quality: C improved Domain@10 by 3 points and Target@20 by 2 points with zero paired regressions.
interpretation.cost: C added 0.39 discovery queries and about 1469 ms average model-plus-search latency per case.
interpretation.absolute_quality: Both A and C remain weak on the harder v2 set; the result supports C over A but does not show production readiness.
interpretation.cross_benchmark: Do not compare these absolute percentages directly with the older 50-case benchmark because the cases differ.

limitations: The development set is manually curated realistic data, not user logs and not a blind test.
This benchmark measures discovery only; it does not include fetch, extraction, evidence, answer generation, or final-result recall.
The paired design controls Q1 by reusing exactly the same candidates, but Q2 is still a live Bing request and live results can vary.
Category groups with fewer than ten cases are diagnostic only.
No labels or runtime rules were changed after observing the run.
